title: Not Addressed
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 115
medium: Interactive page (index.html): twelve still works about one year of hourly bicycle counts on Seattle's Fremont Bridge, each made by a fresh maker from one brief, shown as a grid; one button reveals where the word 'orchard' stood for each maker (folder name, parent folder, an empty file, the data's first line, the brief, nowhere) and what each did with it. Each work opens live. A figure (figure.svg); a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Finding a form, at the edge of the brief. One word was placed in the surround of eight machine makers and addressed to none of them; two were told it as their title; two never met it. None of the eight made or named an orchard; three noticed the word and set it aside, saying so only in their reports. Both makers who were told it planted the same orchard. The rest converged on a shared mould: four of twelve titled their work Two Tides.
project_step: Eleventh experiment of the project. Operation: finding a form (with choosing material). Takes Session 114's open thread 1 and its F-195 (the folder name became the theme) and makes the leak the only variable, with the brief, the data and the viewport held fixed; takes F-196 into the brief by asking for a still. Contradicts the project document's claim, written after experiment 10, that for a machine maker no text in reach is incidental. Works against and with Cartography, not Tracing §4.2 (the order-word; circumstances as constitutive) and with Iteration, not Imitation §4 K6b (the associated milieu).
material: City of Seattle, Fremont Bridge Bicycle Counter (dataset 65db-xm6k), hourly, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, 8,760 rows (one missing), public domain; raw file committed in sources/; domain: urban mobility (bicycle traffic)
seed: prepare.py seed 115 (assignment of conditions to makers); mask.py seed 1150 (blind order of pictures); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
